title: The party at a glance
summary: Three 2nd-level characters and no arcane caster. [[hild|Hild]] holds the front, [[oswin-tull|Oswin]] scouts and opens locks, and [[maren|Maren]] keeps everyone standing.

characters.name: Maren
characters.saves: Wis +5, Cha +3 (proficient); Str +1, Dex +0, Con +2, Int +0
characters.kit: A holy symbol shaped like a bell, a healer's kit, a lantern.

abilities.heading: Disciple of Life
abilities.body: Her healing spells restore an extra 2 + the spell's level hit points.

abilities.heading: Channel Divinity
abilities.body: Once per short rest, one of two. Preserve Life: restore 10 hit points, shared among creatures within 30 feet, none above half its maximum. Turn Undead: each undead within 30 feet that fails a DC 13 Wisdom save flees for a minute, which matters for the ringers in [[L1 area 5]].

characters.backstory: [[wenna-brask|Wenna]]'s niece, raised in town and sent to Millbrook as a girl to learn her letters from the old priest. She took the chapel's faith with her when she left, and came back for the harvest to find the bell silent and her cousin [[tam-brask|Tam]] gone.

hooks.heading: The chapel was hers first
hooks.body: Maren learned her faith in the chapel above the undercroft. When Aldous's part in it comes out she takes it personally, and the village looks to her to say what happens to him.

characters.name: Oswin Tull
characters.saves: Dex +5, Int +3 (proficient); Str -1, Con +1, Wis +1, Cha +2
characters.skills: Stealth +7, Perception +5, Sleight of Hand +5, Deception +4
characters.attacks: Shortsword +5 to hit, 1d6 + 3 piercing; Sneak Attack +1d6
characters.kit: Thieves' tools, a shortbow he never practises with, a pair of loaded dice.
characters.dmOnly: [[grask]] knows Oswin. Oswin lost ten gold to the bugbear at the alehouse dice table last autumn, at the same table as Brother Aldous, and never paid. The rest of the table doesn't know. Grask greets him by name.

abilities.heading: Cunning Action
abilities.body: Dash, Disengage or Hide as a bonus action.

abilities.heading: Lucky
abilities.body: Rerolls a natural 1 on an attack roll, ability check or saving throw.

characters.backstory: A drover's son who never took to droving. He came to Millbrook with the autumn herds, stayed for the dice at the alehouse, and has owed somebody money ever since.

hooks.heading: Ten gold
hooks.body: Oswin owes [[grask]] ten gold. If Grask lives long enough to talk, he says so in front of everyone.

characters.name: Hild
characters.attacks: Warhammer +5 to hit, 1d8 + 3 bludgeoning; handaxe +5 to hit, 1d6 + 3 slashing
characters.kit: Smith's tools, a lantern, and Scrap.

abilities.heading: Protection
abilities.body: With her shield up, she can use her reaction to give disadvantage to an attack against someone else within 5 feet of her.

abilities.heading: Second Wind and Action Surge
abilities.body: Once each per short rest: regain 1d10 + 2 hit points as a bonus action, or take one extra action on her turn.

characters.backstory: A dwarf smith's apprentice who walked away from her master's forge and took up the hammer for other work. Her master cast bells, so she knows a founders' workshop the moment she sees one.

hooks.heading: A founder's eye
hooks.body: Hild can tell whether the slumped clapper can be saved, and could recast it herself, given a week at a proper forge.

notes.heading: Family business
notes.body: [[maren]] is [[wenna-brask|Wenna]]'s niece and [[tam-brask|Tam]]'s cousin, so the first quest is personal for her. Let her player do the talking at the mill.

notes.heading: Two debts, one bugbear
notes.body: [[oswin-tull|Oswin]] owes [[grask]] ten gold, and Brother Aldous owes him far more. Neither knows about the other. Put them in a room together and let it come out.

openQuestions.heading: Scrap
openQuestions.body: Does Sam want Scrap to fight, or only to tag along? It decides whether the goblin goes into initiative at all.
